exercises.name: display_file
exercises.description: Program that displays the content of a file given as argument. Errors: 'File name missing.', 'Too many arguments.', 'Cannot read file.'

exercises.name: cat
exercises.description: Reimplementation of cat: reads files (or stdin) and writes to stdout. Fixed buffer <30KB.

exercises.name: tail
exercises.description: Reimplementation of tail -c (bytes). No +/- signs. Handle multiple files.

exercises.name: hexdump
exercises.description: Reimplementation of hexdump -C (canonical hex+ASCII). No redirection.
